thread:
carlos m: Heads up  my referral specialist visit (neuro consult) got denied as out-of-network even though the clinic is in-network. EOB says billing provider not contracted. Anyone seen NPI mismatch issues?

jamie (people-ops): Oof. Which plan and did the clinic confirm they billed under their group NPI vs individual doc?

carlos m: Plus plan. Clinic says they used Dr. Patel's individual NPI but carrier matched it to a different tax ID. Claim # 2026-9901. I uploaded EOB and referral to the portal.

nina (benefits): Hi Carlos  this is a common taxonomy/NPI mapping problem: carrier networks sometimes link contract to a group's billing NPI, not the clinician's rendering NPI. We can request re-adjudication with provider attribution showing the clinic group as the billing entity. Can you DM last 4 of member ID and the clinic billing NPI?

people-ops-bot: Please upload docs to https://benefits.redwood-inc/claims-upload. Carrier provider line: 1-800-555-PRV. Don't post PHI in channel.

carlos m: DM'd last 4 = 4321. Clinic billing NPI = 1234567890. Uploaded EOB + referral.

nina (benefits): Thanks. We'll open intake ticket and ask carrier to reprocess linking claim to the group's contract. If carrier asks for a provider letter, we can draft one. Typical carrier response 3-5 business days.

jamie (people-ops): If reprocess fails, is OON reimbursement the fallback?

nina (benefits): Yes  appeal/reprocess first. If denied and provider truly OON, you can submit for OON reimbursement via the portal. We'll keep this thread updated. Intake ticket BP-2026-1222 created.

carlos m: Appreciate it. Please escalate if carrier slow.

people-ops-bot: Ticket BP-2026-1222 assigned to benefits intake. ETA carrier response: 3 business days.
